subject: WAGES
bill.title: Establishes protected leave under "Family Leave Act" and family temporary disability leave benefits for bereavement for death of child, miscarriage, stillbirth, and certain other circumstances.

action.description: Reported out of Senate Committee with Amendments, 2nd Reading

posted_text:
❤️‍🩹 NJ S2046 — NJ Expands Bereavement Leave for Parents

New Jersey is clarifying employee leave rights.

This bill adds bereavement leave to the existing Family Leave Act, allowing employees to take time off to grieve the death of a child, or to cope with miscarriage, stillbirth, or termination of a pregnancy for medical reasons.

It covers situations where the employee is a biological parent, or a parent through a gestational carrier agreement.

The bill also extends temporary disability leave benefits to cover these same circumstances, ensuring employees can access needed support during these difficult times.

Oct. 1, 2026: Reported out of Senate Committee with Amendments, 2nd Reading.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.njleg.state.nj.us/bill-search/2026/S2046
